name: Unidentified heavy freighter; (Wreckage after Holdo maneuver)
description: A Resistance heavy freighter was active in the galaxy during the time of the First Order-Resistance War. Concurrently with the Battle of Exegol in 35 ABY, the freighter came into contact with a First Order Resurgent-class Star Destroyer above the Forest Moon of Endor. Utilizing a technique known as the Holdo maneuver, the crew of the freighter rammed into the Star Destroyer at lightspeed, sacrificing themselves to destroy the fearsome vessel.
